[DE|Local] rbb24 Der Tag in Berlin und Brandenburg (Berlin) (Mon 19:17): Studentenproteste | Video-Überwachung | Stadt in Angst
item.description:
Originally published Mon 26 Oct 2026 19:17 IST.
In ganz Europa protestieren junge Menschen für eine bessere Zukunft. Auch in Deutschland sollen am Samstag bundesweit Demos stattfinden. Was halten Studierende in Berlin davon? Weitere Themen: Pläne für Videoüberwachung in Brandenburg, Tatverdächtiger nach Bluttat in Ortrand aus U-Haft entlassen. Und: Deutsch-polnische Gesundheitskooperation vor dem Aus?   "DER TAG in Berlin und Brandenburg" – kompakt und informativ mit dem Neuesten aus Ihrer Region. Abonnieren und hören können Sie den Podcast in ARD Sounds. "DER TAG" gibt es auch im Vorabendprogramm im rbb-Fernsehen, immer montags bis freitags 18 Uhr.

item.title: [EN|In-Depth] BBC Global News Podcast (Mon 18:31): Leaderless student movement wins Serbian election
item.description:
Originally published Mon 26 Oct 2026 18:31 IST.

Serbia's long-standing leader, Aleksander Vučić, is defeated in parliamentary elections by the Student List Party. The movement grew out of protests against corruption and authoritarianism. Also: we speak to Israelis about what many see as the most critical election in their history. Brazil's incumbent left-wing President, Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva, wins a stunning victory in a run-off vote. Around 300 top politicians gather in Beijing, as China's communist leadership holds its most important meeting of the year. And cars, buses, taxis and bicycles disappear from a section of Oxford Street, as pedestrians take over London's famous shopping thoroughfare.

The Global News Podcast brings you the breaking news you need to hear, as it happens. Listen for the latest headlines and current affairs from around the world. Politics, economics, climate, business, technology, health – we cover it all with expert analysis and insight.
